evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.979 Torr at approximately 100 sccm Ar before growth.
Pressure increased to 3.164 Torr during growth, continuing a sustained upward trend.

Pressure reached 3.298 Torr despite stable Ar flow (100.3 sccm), temperature (750.2 C), and low exhaust oxygen (4.7 ppm); this suggests an exhaust restriction or pumping problem rather than an inlet-flow increase.

args.missing_evidence: Check exhaust conductance and pumping performance to distinguish an exhaust blockage from other pressure-control or gauge faults; sample characterization is not yet available.
